summary: Iteration 49: Receipt/Invoice PDF Generation Backend Testing Complete - All 12 tests passed. Verified all receipt-related endpoints for Zelle payment PDF generation.

frontend_issues.note: Frontend testing skipped as requested - React Native/Expo app

GET /api/receipt-logo.description: Returns base64 encoded PNG logo (81,680 chars). Logo starts with 'iVBOR' confirming valid PNG base64 encoding.

GET /api/receipts/session/{id} - Admin.description: Admin can access receipt data for any session. Returns all required fields including receiptNumber, totalCents, trainerPayoutCents, platformFeeCents, paymentMethod=Zelle, paymentStatus.

GET /api/receipts/session/{id} - Trainee.description: Trainee can access receipt for their own sessions. Returns isTrainee=true flag.

GET /api/receipts/session/{id} - Trainer.description: Trainer can access receipt for their own sessions. Returns isTrainer=true flag.

Receipt Amount Calculations.description: 80/20 split verified - trainer gets 80% ($60.00 of $75.00), platform gets 20% ($15.00)

Authentication Required.description: Endpoint correctly returns 401/403 for unauthenticated requests

GET /api/admin/receipts.description: Admin can get list of all verified Zelle payment receipts. Returns {receipts: [], total: count}. Currently 1 verified receipt.

GET /api/trainer/sessions.description: SessionResponse model includes zellePaymentStatus field. Trainer sessions show zellePaymentStatus=verified for session 69a9d9ef7f7a0df960c5cd54.

GET /api/trainee/sessions.description: Trainee sessions also include zellePaymentStatus field in response.

critical_code_review_comments: All 8 requested features are working correctly

80/20 revenue split is correctly calculated (trainer 80%, platform 20%)
zellePaymentStatus field is properly included in SessionResponse model
Proper authorization checks in place (admin-only endpoints return 403 for non-admins)
Receipt number format is RR-{last 8 chars of session ID in uppercase}
